name: Banner
purpose: Report an outcome or a needed action inside the current context.
description: One outcome with optional context. Colour carries the sentiment; the text carries the meaning.

tone.description: success and info report an outcome; warning and danger an exception. The message still says which.

icon.description: Syntari icon name. The registry index lists every name as icons.

guidance.summary: Reports an exception or an outcome inside the current context: something wrong, at risk, or just completed.
useWhen: Something is wrong or about to be, and the person should know before anything else on the screen.
An action finished and the person needs to know its outcome in place.

avoidWhen.text: A normal status: put it in a badge beside the item.
The person must decide before continuing.

states.label: Default
states.description: An icon, a message, and a detail, in the tone of what happened: success, info, warning, or danger.

dos.title: Exceptions lead
dos.description: A banner that is present is the first thing people read.

dos.title: The message says what to do
dos.description: Two overdue reviews: open the oldest first.

donts.title: Restating the queue
donts.description: “You have 6 items” is the list's job, not an exception.

donts.title: A banner on every screen
donts.description: When there is always a banner, none is noticed.

donts.title: Tone as the only signal
donts.description: The message says it is a warning in words.

content: The message is a sentence of under 90 characters; the detail says what to do.

notes: A polite status: it is announced without moving focus.
Tone is shown by colour and stated in the message.

composition.defaultVisible: Only while the exception is present.
composition.density: At most one per screen part.
composition.contentLength: A message under 90 characters and a detail under 160.

redundantWith.reason: A paragraph saying the same thing.

mistakes: An info banner that restates the screen's purpose.
A success banner that stays after the moment passed.
composition.responsive: The detail wraps under the message.
